hook.title: SDD Orchestrator is now live.
hook.purpose: Launch the product and establish the adoption gap.
hook.teachingPoint: SDD is powerful; the workflow around its skills has been hard to see.
hook.subtitle: SDD starts with a strong idea: begin with intent and keep the work connected.

headline: Clear intent.

problem.title: Powerful skills. Missing workflow.
problem.purpose: Name the real blockers without blaming the method or teams.
problem.teachingPoint: Each adoption question becomes visible at the exact moment the narrator asks it.

questions.text: Which skill should I run first?
What artifacts do I need in place to begin?
How do I know Codex and I are aligned?
Where is this feature in the SDD lifecycle?
And how do I know we did not drift out of scope?

artifactReadiness.question: What needs to be in place?

solution.title: One guided entry point to SDD.
solution.purpose: Introduce the Orchestrator as the missing product layer.
solution.teachingPoint: The Orchestrator coordinates the existing skills and makes lifecycle state visible.
solution.subtitle: The Orchestrator does not replace the SDD skills. It makes them usable.

developer-experience.title: Start naturally in Codex.
developer-experience.purpose: Show exactly how an engineer starts or resumes a run.
developer-experience.teachingPoint: A natural-language Codex prompt starts the guided, stateful workflow.
developer-experience.subtitle: One clear prompt starts a new stateful run—or resumes an existing one.
promptLines: Pause when human review is required.
Keep scope bounded to approved requirements.

workflow.title: Track the lifecycle.
workflow.purpose: Show the end-to-end lifecycle, human gates, and attached evidence.
workflow.teachingPoint: Every stage exposes completed work, pending approval, next actions, and evidence.
workflow.subtitle: Completed work, pending approvals, validation gates, and evidence stay visible on one rail.

guardrails.title: Friction becomes guardrails.
guardrails.purpose: Connect the adoption blockers directly to practical guardrails.
guardrails.teachingPoint: Guidance, staged review, boundaries, gates, and evidence reduce delivery friction.
guardrails.subtitle: Each role gets a clearer path from adoption friction to an Orchestrator guardrail.
guardrails.communityLine: One shared entry point to improve SDD together
